tools.name: measure_geojson
tools.description: Measures the geodesic area, perimeter and length of each feature of a GeoJSON and returns them per feature with totals, in square meters and meters. To change the CRS use reproject_geojson, and to buffer, simplify or clean the geometry use transform_geojson. Takes a GeoJSON of up to 50,000 features

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "chat" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
